title: Jim Goetz and Jan Koum at Startup School SV 2014
summary: A Startup School SV 2014 conversation between Sequoia's Jim Goetz and WhatsApp founder Jan Koum. They discuss how Sequoia pursued WhatsApp, its tiny engineering team, and how it handled growth and support.
why: HN mines it for WhatsApp facts, such as pricing used to slow growth, a 7-8 person backend team and late hiring of customer service.

quote.text: WhatsApp actually used pricing as a way to slow their growth and give Jan Koum's team time to scale their infrastructure.
